title: Ep 9 — A fourteen-times-faster OpenAI mode, and the paperwork chatbot that quietly hit sixty thousand a month
description: OpenAI previews a fourteen-times-faster Ultrafast inference mode and reportedly tops a forty-billion-dollar revenue run rate ahead of a possible IPO, while Claude Code ships cross-session agent messaging and Microsoft begins retiring free Copilot features on the eighteenth of August. Plus a deep dive on niching a document-chat tool for grant and compliance paperwork, evidence-backed by PDF.ai's real run to sixty thousand dollars a month, and a quiet week for the Fundraising Regulator's prize-draw ruling and EV-Partnerships.
